summary: Live Oak Bancshares filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an offering of 4,000,000 depositary shares, each representing a 1/40th interest in a share of 8.750% Fixed Rate Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock, Series B, with a $25 per depositary share liquidation preference ($1,000 per underlying share). This is a routine regulatory-capital preferred issuance, not a special situation. Dividends, if declared, accrue quarterly from issuance beginning December 15, 2026; the shares rank pari passu with the existing Series A preferred and senior to common. Redemption is optional from December 15, 2031, or within 90 days of a regulatory capital treatment event, subject to approval. NYSE listing under LOB PRB is pending application. Watch for pricing terms, dividend coverage, and capital-ratio impact.
